## Description
Time-Domain Electromagnetic (TDEM) Sounder: This is the most effective method for &#10;&#9;&#9;deep groundwater (up to 5 km depth).  It uses a ballistically deployed wire loop to induce &#10;&#9;&#9;eddy currents in the subsurface, detecting the high electrical conductivity of saline water &#10;&#9;&#9;that has been isolated from atmospheric circulation for eons. &#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;Mars Time Domain Electromagnetic Sounder prototype was built by Southwest Research Institute&#10;&#9;&#9;(SWRI) and the University of Colorado Boulder, funded by NASA, and reached TRL 5 (prototype &#10;&#9;&#9;demonstrated in a relevant environment).&#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;https://phys.org/news/2009-06-instrument-potential-deep-underground-mars.html
